rootCause.classificationNote: No literal recursive `grep -r`/`find` over a home/root path exists anywhere in src/ or scripts/ in this repo. `grep -rl AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW` occurs only as normal within-file string matches inside src/admission/registry.mjs, src/governance/review-bundle.mjs, and several scripts/*.mjs — none of them shell out to a recursive filesystem search. No docs/ policy text matching 'verify globally / no other / ensure none exists' patterns was found either, so this is not case D (legacy governance instructions) as far as this repo's committed docs go.

rootCause.conclusion: The 896s whole-home grep was an ad-hoc command an agent (Pi) improvised at runtime to answer 'is anything still AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW', in the absence of (a) a call to the existing authoritative reader, and (b) any code-level guard preventing an arbitrarily broad verification root. It is not hardcoded in AutoLoop source and not traceable to a specific policy instruction in this repo's docs. Root cause is agent-generated ad-hoc verification operating with unbounded scope, unconstrained by any guard — not a defect to fix by editing a specific script.

semantics.forbiddenAppliesTo: any resolved path equal to, or a descendant of, a forbidden root, UNLESS it is also within an authorized root
authorizedRootsDefault: this repo (resolved from the module's own location)
semantics.failClosed: checkVerificationRoot never widens scope on its own; ok:false callers MUST surface HOLD / VERIFICATION_SCOPE_UNBOUNDED. assertVerificationRoot throws an Error with .hold set to the same code for fail-closed call sites.
semantics.dynamicPathHandling: resolve() is applied before any comparison, so a dynamically-constructed path (e.g. join(home, 'Desktop', '..')) is checked against its resolved form, not its literal string, closing the NEG3 case (agent resolves a parent path to home).

guardImplemented.scopeOfThisPhase: This is the bounded guard primitive only (VCA1-F1 / W1-A). It does not yet implement the full VCA-1 verification-budget system (max_duration_ms / max_files / max_bytes — card section 10), the authoritative-source-first enforcement layer (section 4), the external verdict fast path (section 5), or verification-cost telemetry (section 9). Those remain later VCA-1 phases, explicitly out of scope for this bootstrap per Controller's narrowed authorization.
guardImplemented.coversAgentGeneratedCommands: Partial by design at this phase: the guard is a library function importable by any AutoLoop script or sub-agent adapter. It does not itself intercept an arbitrary shell command Pi might type outside of code that calls it. Closing that gap fully requires either (a) AutoLoop-side verification call sites routing through this guard (not yet done — no call sites wired in this phase), or (b) a policy/prompt-level instruction to Pi to call this guard / use readCloseoutState before any filesystem verification. Recommendation for the next phase: wire runCloseoutGate's readiness checks and any sub-agent shell-verification adapter through checkVerificationRoot before actual traversal, and add the authoritative-source-first requirement (section 4) so the question this grep was answering never reaches a filesystem search.
